title: Evaluating Geographic Lexical Knowledge in Large Language Models Across 21 Spanish-Speaking Countries
abstract: arXiv:2602.09346v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly serve users across regional varieties, yet their knowledge of geographic lexical variation remains insufficiently evaluated. We investigate country-conditioned lexical usage judgments in Spanish using an expert-curated database covering 934 lexical items across 21 Spanish-speaking countries. Treating ten proprietary and open-weight LLMs as virtual informants, we evaluate two complementary question formats: Yes-No question format (YNQF) and multiple-choice question format (MCQF). The evaluation comprises 10,164 YNQF questions and 16,637 MCQF questions, assessed using F1 and an adjusted Jaccard coefficient, respectively. Results reveal substantial differences across models, countries, and formats. Spain receives the highest country-level score for eight models in YNQF and nine in MCQF; Chile receives the lowest MCQF score for every model. translated_title: 评估大型语言模型对21个西班牙语国家地理词汇知识的掌握
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）日益服务于使用不同地区语言变体的用户，但其对地理词汇差异的知识仍缺乏充分评估。我们利用一个由专家精心整理的数据库，研究了西班牙语中依国家而异的词汇使用判断，该数据库涵盖21个西班牙语国家的934个词汇条目。我们将十个专有及开放权重的LLM视为虚拟发音合作人，评估了两种互补的问答格式：是非题格式（YNQF）和多项选择题格式（MCQF）。本次评估包含10,164个YNQF问题和16,637个MCQF问题，分别使用F1值和调整后的Jaccard系数进行评分。结果显示，不同模型、国家和题型之间存在显著差异。在YNQF中，西班牙在八个模型中获得最高的国家级评分；在MCQF中，西班牙在九个模型中得分最高；而智利在所有模型的MCQF中得分均最低。回归分析表明，数字资源量……
tldr: 该研究将十个LLM视为虚拟发音人，基于涵盖21个西班牙语国家934个词汇的专家数据库，系统评估了LLM对西班牙语地理词汇差异的知识，发现模型间、国家间和题型间均存在显著差异，其中西班牙得分最高而智利在选择题格式中得分最低。
en_tdlr: This study treats ten LLMs as virtual informants and, using an expert-curated database of 934 lexical items across 21 Spanish-speaking countries, systematically evaluates their knowledge of geographic lexical variation in Spanish, revealing substantial differences across models, countries, and question formats, with Spain scoring highest and Chile lowest in the multiple-choice format.
